mapper.insert: INSERT INTO purchase (purchase_no, goods_id, goods_name, quantity, unit_price, total_price, supplier, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{purchaseNo}, #{goodsId}, #{goodsName}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{totalPrice}, #{supplier}, #{remark}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM purchase WHERE 1=1 AND goods_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{goodsName}, '%') ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase WHERE 1=1 AND goods_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{goodsName}, '%')
